**I'm M. Fatih Kara** &#127793; &mdash; a plant scientist working on **plant immunity** and
**molecular plant&ndash;microbe interactions (MPMI)**. I study how lettuce defends itself
against the nasty necrotrophic fungi *Botrytis cinerea* and *Sclerotinia sclerotiorum*,
using genome editing and omics.

&#127891; PhD @ University of York (UK) &bull; &#127481;&#127479; based in Ankara, Türkiye
:::
